name: Cheesy Smashed Potatoes with Bacon, Mushrooms, Tomato & Green Onion
instructions: Wash potatoes; transfer to a large pot, add salt, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, about 15 minutes.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Cook in batches if necessary.
Wash and dry the remaining fresh produce.
When the bacon is done, remove and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate. Transfer the bacon fat to a small bowl and set aside, leaving about 2 tsp in the skillet.
Return skillet to medium heat. Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until tender, 3-4 minutes; remove from heat and set aside.
Crumble or chop bacon into small pieces.

When the potatoes are done, drain and transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Using a fork or potato masher, gently crush each potato, flattening them to a 1-inch thickness. Drizzle with 3 tbsp reserved bacon fat and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Sprinkle cheese, mushrooms, and bacon over the potatoes. Place in the oven and bake until cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard ends of green onions, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Small dice tomatoes.
To serve, divide smashed potatoes between plates or bowls. Top with green onion, tomato, and yogurt. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
